title: Waitlist Landing Template
summary: Portfolio demo: high-converting waitlist landing page with lead capture form and mock webhook — reusable template for product launches.
problem: Teams launching a new product need a focused landing page that collects emails without standing up a full marketing stack on day one.
solution: Self-built portfolio demo from the portfolio-templates monorepo (apps/landing-waitlist). Clean hero, social proof placeholders, and a waitlist form that POSTs to a mock webhook endpoint so you can swap in Zapier, n8n, or your API later. Strengthens my workflow automation & AI integration offering and shows evergreen landing-page demand.

zh.title: 候补名单落地页模板
zh.summary: 作品集演示：高转化候补名单落地页 + 留资表单与模拟 webhook，适合产品发布前收集邮箱。
zh.problem: 新产品上线时需要专注的落地页收集邮箱，但第一天不想搭完整营销技术栈。
zh.solution: 自建作品集演示，来自 portfolio-templates  monorepo（apps/landing-waitlist）。简洁主视觉、可替换的社会证明位，以及 POST 到模拟 webhook 的候补表单，之后可换成 Zapier、n8n 或自有 API。对应工作流自动化与 AI 集成能力，也展示落地页类需求的普遍性。
